falseSynonyms.zh: 收銀員不等於所有 teller cashier 一般指商店等處理付款的收銀員；銀行語境通常要說 bank cashier。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A supermarket cashier takes payment for groceries, while a bank teller handles banking transactions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 銀行業專業人士不等於櫃員 banker 範圍很廣，可以是經理或金融專業人士，不特指櫃檯職員。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A banker may advise clients on finance, while a teller commonly handles routine counter transactions.

falseSynonyms.zh: 接待員不等於銀行櫃員 receptionist 主要迎接訪客和提供基本資訊，通常不處理存款或提款。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The receptionist directed me to the counter, where a teller processed my deposit.

falseSynonyms.zh: 會計人員不等於櫃員 accountant 處理帳目和報表，不是一般前線銀行交易職員。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An accountant prepares financial records; a teller serves customers at the bank counter.

falseSynonyms.zh: 客戶服務代表不等於所有 teller 可能處理查詢和戶口問題，但未必直接處理現金交易。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A customer service representative may explain account options, while a teller may process a cash withdrawal.

falseSynonyms.zh: 自動櫃員機不是職員 ATM 是機器，不是人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can withdraw cash from an ATM or ask a teller to process the transaction at the counter.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞和動詞不同 teller 是名詞；tell 是動詞「告訴」。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The teller checked the account. Please tell me your account number.

falseSynonyms.zh: 人和機器不同 teller 通常指銀行職員；automated teller machine 是自動櫃員機。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The teller served the customer at the counter, while the ATM handled another withdrawal.
